csv_project_name: Developer for RHA Brewington Oaks Redevelopment
csv_scope_of_work: Request For Proposal (RFP) NO. 26-133, Brewington Oaks Redevelopment Development Partner The Housing Authority is seeking proposals from qualified development teams to serve as a Development Partner for the redevelopment of Brewington Oaks. The selected Development Partner will work in collaboration with the Housing Authority to implement a redevelopment strategy that transforms the site into a high-quality, sustainable affordable housing community while supporting long-term financial sustainability and operational performance. This procurement is intended to support not only the successful delivery of the project, but also the Housing Authority's broader objectives related to portfolio redevelopment, long-term asset stewardship, and internal capacity building.

title: Developer for RHA Brewington Oaks Redevelopment
short_description: Development partner sought for sustainable affordable housing redevelopment in Rockford, Illinois.
project_scope: Redevelopment of the Brewington Oaks site into a high-quality, sustainable affordable housing community. The selected development partner is to collaborate with the Rockford Housing Authority on redevelopment strategy, project delivery, long-term financial sustainability, operational performance, portfolio redevelopment, asset stewardship, and internal capacity building. No gross floor area, unit count, structural system, or other technical building characteristics are stated.
services: Development partner services; design-build/developer services; housing and urban development; redevelopment planning; urban studies/planning/design.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a developer/RFP for redevelopment partnership, not a structural or specialist engineering tender.
- Focus is on affordable housing redevelopment, strategy, and portfolio objectives rather than complex structural design.
- No information on spans, long-span roofs, special structures, or architecturally demanding building systems.
- Urban planning and development management components dominate, which are generally of limited relevance to sbp.
- Could involve building design indirectly, but the notice does not specify structural engineering scope.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Useful missing inputs for an estimate include site area, number of housing units, gross floor area, building heights, construction type, phasing, and redevelopment extent.
fee_explanation: No engineering fee is stated. The notice is for a development partner rather than a defined structural engineering commission, so an sbp fee cannot be estimated realistically from the available information.
references_qualifications: Proposals are sought from qualified development teams to serve as Development Partner. No specific minimum reference projects, qualification thresholds, or discipline-specific credential requirements are stated in the source.
